description: This file implements certificate compression and decompression logic for QUIC protocol, including handling of certificate chains, zlib compression with custom dictionaries, and certificate hash matching.

classes.name: ScopedZLib
classes.description: Manages automatic cleanup of zlib inflate/deflate streams.

classes.name: CertEntry
classes.description: Represents a certificate entry in compressed form, with types for cached or compressed certificates.

methods.name: CertCompressor::CompressChain
methods.description: Compresses a chain of certificates into a zlib-compressed format with a custom dictionary.

methods.name: CertCompressor::DecompressChain
methods.description: Decompresses a certificate chain from the compressed format, resolving cached certificates.

methods.name: MatchCerts
methods.description: Matches certificates against client cached hashes to determine compression strategy.

methods.name: CertEntriesSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of serialized certificate entries.

methods.name: SerializeCertEntries
methods.description: Serializes certificate entries into a byte buffer.

methods.name: ZlibDictForEntries
methods.description: Generates a zlib dictionary based on certificate entries and cached certificates.

methods.name: HashCerts
methods.description: Computes FNV-1a hashes for a list of certificates.

methods.name: ParseEntries
methods.description: Parses serialized certificate entries from input data.
